title: A Profile-Separation Framework for Quantitative Convergence of No-U-Turn Samplers
summary:
We study multinomial and biased-progressive No-U-Turn Samplers for strongly log-concave targets satisfying $mI_d\preceq 
abla^2U(x)\preceq LI_d,$ and $\|
abla^2U(x)-
abla^2U(y)\|_{\mathrm F}\le γL^{3/2}\|x-y\|$ with \(κ\coloneqq L/m\). We introduce profile separation, a sufficient sign condition on the stationary mean U-turn diagnostics, and combine it with diagnostic concentration, leapfrog fidelity, and whole-orbit energy control to show that on a high-probability certification event, every doubling realization reaches a common terminal depth through a genuine U-turn.
